El País publishes the TSR map Adif ordered withdrawn

📅 2026-03-13 🏷️ El País, TSR map, Adif, Spain, railway, train speed restrictions, cartography, press freedom
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

Spanish newspaper El País published a map of train speed restrictions that railway infrastructure administrator Adif had ordered withdrawn, highlighting tensions between information access and operational security in transport mapping.

📌 Key takeaways

  • El País published a TSR (Temporary Speed Restriction) map for Spanish railways that Adif had ordered removed from public access
  • Adif is Spain's national railway infrastructure administrator responsible for the rail network
  • The incident raises questions about the balance between public information rights and transport safety or security
  • Railway speed restriction maps can be relevant to both passengers and safety investigators
  • The conflict between a major newspaper and a state infrastructure agency over map publication represents a broader cartographic transparency issue
